cues.en: Mike Cohen: Here is another unsupervised learning challenge for you.
cues.zh: 再給你一個「非監督式學習」挑戰。

cues.en: Again, this is an opportunity for you to explore the concepts that I'm teaching in this course in code, either in MATLAB or in Python.
cues.zh: 這是用MATLAB或Python程式，探索課程概念的機會。

cues.en: And I'm not gonna tell you my solutions, I don't provide code for these solutions, this is just your opportunity to explore statistics concepts in code.
cues.zh: 我不會提供解法或解答程式，只是讓你用程式探索統計概念。

cues.en: Okay, so what you want to do is compare the mean and the median for distributions that you create.
cues.zh: 要做的是，比較自己建立的分布中，平均值與中位數。

cues.en: So I'm not telling you what kinds of distributions, you can use normal distributions or log normal or any kind of distribution you like.
cues.zh: 不指定分布類型，可以是常態、對數常態，或任何你喜歡的。

cues.en: And essentially you're going to compare the mean versus the median in four different distributions.
cues.zh: 基本上，要在四種不同分布中，比較平均與中位數。

cues.en: One distribution where you create, or I guess it's a pair of distributions, where you create small outliers.
cues.zh: 一種，或者應說一對分布，要建立小離群值。

cues.en: So you're going to put outliers into the data.
cues.zh: 在資料中放離群值。

cues.en: Now, I haven't spent a lot of time talking about outliers yet, that comes up in the next section, but suffice it to say that an outlier is an unusually large value in the dataset.
cues.zh: 目前還沒花很多時間介紹，下一節會談，但只要知道，它是資料集中異常大的值。

cues.en: That can be unusually large off to the right, like in this case, it can be, let's say the number 30 might be an outlier, you can also have unusually small outliers
cues.zh: 可以是偏右的大值，這個例子可能30就是離群值，也能有異常小的值，

cues.en: to the negative side of the distribution, so like minus 10.
cues.zh: 在分布負的方向，例如−10。

cues.en: And what I want you to do is have small outliers, and by small I mean that it's not really far away from the distribution.
cues.zh: 我要你放入小離群值，「小」指與分布距離沒有非常遠。

cues.en: So a small outlier for this particular distribution might be, for example, how about the number 20.
cues.zh: 這個分布的小離群值，例如20。

cues.en: So the number 20 is unusual.
cues.zh: 20不尋常。

cues.en: It's outside this distribution.
cues.zh: 在這個分布外。

cues.en: But it's not really, really, so far away from the distribution.
cues.zh: 但並沒有離分布非常非常遠。

cues.en: Versus large outliers, if this distribution goes up to 14,
cues.zh: 相較之下，大離群值，若分布最高到14，

cues.en: that's the highest value, maybe a large outlier might be 10,000 or a million or a trillion.
cues.zh: 大離群值可能是10,000、一百萬，或一兆。

cues.en: So it's up to you.
cues.zh: 由你決定。

cues.en: I'm leaving these in quotes intentionally because I want you to explore this a little bit.
cues.zh: 刻意加引號，是希望你稍微探索。

cues.en: But basically outliers that are kind of close to the distribution versus outliers that are really far away.
cues.zh: 基本上，離群值一種比較接近分布，一種距離非常遠。

cues.en: And then see how the mean versus the median is affected by these two different distances of outliers.
cues.zh: 看看這兩種距離，如何影響平均值與中位數。

cues.en: And then you can repeat this experiment for small data sets versus large data sets.
cues.zh: 再對小資料集與大資料集，重複這個實驗。

cues.en: Again, it's up to you to figure out what small and large means, but I would recommend somewhere around for small-N maybe something like 10 to 50,
cues.zh: 同樣由你決定大小，但建議小N大概10到50，

cues.en: you can explore different distributions of size, 10 to 50.
cues.zh: 可以探索大小10到50的不同分布。

cues.en: And for large-N, you can really go nuts with this, but I would say maybe try a hundred, try a thousand, and that's a pretty decent range.
cues.zh: 大N可以盡情嘗試，但建議100、1000，這是不錯的範圍。

cues.en: So somewhere between a hundred and a thousand for a large-N dataset.
cues.zh: 大型N資料集，大約100到1000之間。

cues.en: So good luck, I hope you enjoy working through this unsupervised learning code challenge.
cues.zh: 祝順利，希望享受這個自主學習程式挑戰。

cues.en: If you discover something interesting, then feel free to post it to the Q and A.
cues.zh: 如果發現有趣的事情，歡迎在問與答分享。
